Date: 2026-08-16

Primary theme: **Speech and Transcript Evidence**

Historical Stage 0.5d disposition: **Not ready for comparison**

Stage 0.5e mechanism disposition: **Ready for a fresh aligned-English
quality panel**

Stage 0.5f quality disposition: **Construct-invalid for ASR quality; not
promoted**

## Plain-English result

The original Stage 0.5d run was one fresh eight-video English speech test of
Qwen3-ASR plus the Qwen forced aligner. The container itself worked, but Qwen
returned no transcript for two videos. Six videos produced valid aligned
output. Because a fair comparison required all eight rows, that test remains
recorded as `not_ready`.

This does **not** show that Qwen is better or worse than Whisper. The paired
quality score was intentionally not created when two rows failed.

The completed Stage 0.5f follow-up forced English on 12 new question-selected
speech rows. It passed the operational gate with `12/12` completed and
`12/12` valid aligned outputs, so the frozen quality inputs were opened. The
predeclared exact official-answer-phrase metric was `0/12` for Qwen and
`0/12` for Whisper, with all 12 rows in the paired neither-present cell.
The calculation and frozen row booleans reproduce, but a private read-only
audit found that the panel did not measure what the metric assumed: only one
row directly requested a recoverable literal phrase or name, while ten rows
did not support exact transcript containment. The forced-English condition
therefore supplies valid `12/12` operational evidence, but the `0`/`0` result
is construct-invalid for comparing ASR quality and does not advance Qwen.

## Frozen condition

- Eight fresh English exact-speech WAV rows from the preserved oracle panel.
- Prior Qwen rows were excluded before preparation.
- Requests contained only run/condition/video identity, an absolute WAV path,
  and `mode=transcription`.
- ASR revision: `7278e1e70fe206f11671096ffdd38061171dd6e5`.
- Forced-aligner revision: `c7cbfc2048c462b0d63a45797104fc9db3ad62b7`.
- Digest-pinned offline ROCm container, read-only mounts, and one attempt.
- Paid cost: `$0.00`.

## Observed result

| Measure | Result |
|---|---:|
| Required rows | 8 |
| Completed rows | 6 |
| Valid aligned rows | 6 |
| Empty-output failures | 2 |
| Container exit code | 0 |
| Maximum allocated memory | 6,161,528,320 bytes |
| Container elapsed time | 64.105 seconds |
| Frozen decision | `not_ready` |

The two failures were deterministic `Qwen3-ASR returned empty text` runner
errors. The raw output, terminal record, validation, and prediction freeze
were preserved without retry or relabeling.

## Interpretation boundary

This is a zero-cost incomplete-output diagnostic. It establishes that the
corrected harness can process multiple rows, but not that the model has better
transcript fidelity, better timestamps, downstream VQA value, or replacement
value relative to Whisper. A future attempt would need a separately frozen
panel and an explicit resolution for empty Qwen output.

## Stage 0.5e empty-output mechanism diagnostic

Date: 2026-08-16

### Question and decision rule

The follow-up tested whether the two preserved empty outputs were reproduced
by the aligned automatic-language path and whether forcing `language="English"`
removed them under the same pinned Qwen models and offline runtime. The
predeclared decision rule was: if the aligned automatic-language baseline
reproduces both failures and the aligned-English treatment completes all four
rows with valid alignment, advance only a fresh quality panel using that
English-language condition. The four diagnostic rows are never scored.

### Frozen method and panel

- Four rows selected from the frozen Stage 0.5d results in request order: the
  two preserved empty-output failures and the first two preserved passing
  controls.
- Four process-isolated arms ran once, in order, with read-only mounts,
  `--network none`, pinned model revisions, and `$0.00` paid compute.
- Qwen3-ASR revision:
  `7278e1e70fe206f11671096ffdd38061171dd6e5`; forced-aligner revision:
  `c7cbfc2048c462b0d63a45797104fc9db3ad62b7`.
- The diagnostic froze before any labels, annotations, Whisper text, or
  scoring inputs were opened. Row-level Qwen outputs remained private and
  were never manually inspected or scored, but deterministic validation and
  the original host selector did programmatically read transcript/alignment
  fields as disclosed below.

### Post-run protocol correction

Independent review found a confirmed protocol deviation in the original host
selector: for rows already marked `passed`, it redundantly read and stripped
the private `text`, `language`, and `chunks` fields. The predeclared design
allowed selection from status, error, order, identity, duration, and hash
metadata only. The selector did not copy those values into the diagnostic,
and labels, annotations, Whisper text, and scoring inputs remained unopened.

This deviation did not change the frozen panel or the aggregate mechanism
result. Stage 0.5d's separately frozen validation records six completed rows
and six valid alignments, so every one of its six `passed` rows had already
met the transcript/alignment contract; the first two passed statuses in frozen
order are therefore the same two controls. Neither frozen experiment was
rerun. The host harness now cross-checks only passed/failed statuses against
those frozen completion/alignment counts, and a regression test fails if
selection accesses any private transcript field.

### Observed result

| Arm | Condition | Successes | Failures | Valid aligned | Validation | Wall seconds |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|
| A `aligned_auto` | aligner, automatic language, timestamps on | 2/4 | 2 | 2/4 | `not_ready` | 46.722 |
| B `base_auto` | no aligner, automatic language, timestamps off | 2/4 | 2 | 0/4 | `not_ready` | 46.691 |
| C `aligner_plain_auto` | aligner, automatic language, timestamps off | 2/4 | 2 | 0/4 | `not_ready` | 46.294 |
| D `aligned_english` | aligner, English, timestamps on | 4/4 | 0 | 4/4 | `ready` | 47.787 |

All four arm terminals exited `0` and were contract-valid. Maximum peak
memory was 6,175,102,976 bytes for A, 4,331,441,664 for B,
6,175,102,464 for C, and 6,174,173,184 for D. The frozen status is
`diagnostic_frozen`; baseline reproducibility is `true`; the advancing arm is
`aligned_english`; and the decision is
`ready_for_fresh_aligned_quality_panel`.

### Interpretation boundary

On this four-row frozen mechanism panel, forcing `language="English"` removed
the two preserved empty-output failures. Each automatic-language explanatory
arm remained at `2` successes and `2` failures, and neither restored all four
rows. The bounded evidence therefore points to the automatic-language path
association rather than merely loading the aligner or requesting timestamps;
it is not an internal causal bug claim. This is condition-bound mechanism
evidence, not a transcript-quality result, Whisper comparison, or downstream
VQA result. The four rows remain unscored, and the original Stage 0.5d summary
remains preserved in the evidence bundle.

### Authorized next action, now completed

Run a new label-blind aligned-English Qwen quality panel using no reused Qwen
rows. Hold the comparator, media, model revisions, prompts, decoding, and
all-row readiness gate fixed; load labels only after every prediction freezes.
At the Stage 0.5e freeze, this was the authorized next action rather than a
completed run. It was subsequently completed as Stage 0.5f and is recorded
below; the historical Stage 0.5e mechanism decision remains unchanged.

## Stage 0.5f fresh aligned-English quality test

Date: 2026-08-16

### Question, hypothesis, and predeclared rule

The completed follow-up asked whether the pinned Qwen3-ASR plus forced-aligner
path would finish a fresh question-indicated speech panel when every request
fixed `language="English"`, and whether its transcript contained the task's
complete official answer phrase more often than the already frozen Whisper
comparator. Any operational failure would have frozen `not_ready` without
opening score inputs. After a `12/12` ready freeze, only a strictly higher Qwen
containment count would have authorized a larger confirmatory or downstream
test; a tie or lower count would stop this Qwen quality route.

### Frozen method and integrity boundary

- The selector used only the ordered 475-row question/identity manifest, WAV
  metadata, and a complete private Qwen3-ASR exposure census. It selected the
  first eligible fresh rows in fixed `6` reported-speech, `3` conversation,
  and `3` vocalization strata, restored to manifest order. It did not open
  annotations, answers, Whisper content or status, prior Qwen output content,
  maps, grades, or scores.
- The exposure census classified all `57` exact marker-bearing private
  JSON/JSONL files: `52` genuine exposure sources and five marker-bearing files
  within two fully inventoried preparation-only roots that had never begun an
  inference attempt. The ledger bound all six files in those roots, zero
  attempt artifacts, the preserved selection fingerprint, and `16` excluded
  prior/oracle identities. The fresh selector replayed the same 12-row private
  fingerprint before execution.
- The one attempt bound the Qwen3-ASR and forced-aligner revisions above, the
  digest-pinned offline ROCm image, BF16/SDPA, forced English, timestamps on,
  read-only mounts, `--network none`, source audio hashes/durations, committed
  controller revision `d9e43c94c2e441f5bc85508ed1b41d738e33289f`, and
  `$0.00` paid compute.
- Predictions, terminal evidence, validation, and their freeze were written
  before the scorer opened the canonical annotations and checksum-bound frozen
  Whisper artifact. Row identities, transcripts, answers, and row-level scores
  remain private.

### Observed result

| Measure | Result |
|---|---:|
| Required rows | 12 |
| Completed rows | 12 |
| Valid aligned rows | 12 |
| Failures | 0 |
| Container exit code | 0 |
| Container wall time | 110.416 seconds |
| Summed row inference time | 102.241 seconds |
| Maximum allocated memory | 6,162,299,392 bytes |
| Qwen complete official phrase present | 0/12 |
| Whisper complete official phrase present | 0/12 |
| Both present | 0 |
| Qwen only present | 0 |
| Whisper only present | 0 |
| Neither present | 12 |
| Operational decision | `ready_for_quality_test` |
| Quality decision | `no_directional_difference` |

### Interpretation, validity, and decision

- **Evidence validity:** **Operationally valid; construct-invalid for ASR
  quality.** The sole attempt and all-row gate completed, and scoring occurred
  only after the verified prediction freeze. The stored booleans and `0`/`0`
  aggregate reproduce; the defect is the relationship between the selected
  tasks and the metric, not the calculation.
- **Decision disposition:** **Not promoted under the tested condition.**
  The forced-English condition completed this fresh panel without an
  empty-output failure. The containment score cannot support a Qwen-versus-
  Whisper quality comparison because the keyword selector admitted mostly
  non-literal tasks.
- **What this rules out now:** the need for another same-condition completion
  diagnostic, a claim that this exact test supplies a Qwen quality advantage,
  and scaling the same selector/metric combination.
- **What it does not establish:** WER, transcript fidelity, timestamp accuracy,
  general English robustness, Whisper replacement value, downstream VQA
  improvement, or model ranking. A `0`/`0` containment tie is
  non-discriminating and does not imply that both transcripts were equally
  accurate or equally inaccurate.
- **Confirmed construct defect:** official VQA answers are not transcript
  references. The selector's speech-related question keywords did not ensure
  that the requested answer was a literal spoken phrase. Exact answer-phrase
  containment therefore did not measure transcript fidelity on this panel.
- **Reconsider when:** a separately designed experiment has independently
  grounded transcript references or a frozen downstream VQA decision rule.
  Do not scale or rerun this same containment comparison.
- **Supersession:** this result completes the action authorized by Stage 0.5e;
  it does not supersede the valid Stage 0.5d incomplete-output observation or
  the Stage 0.5e mechanism result.

### Post-hoc metric audit

The read-only audit re-hashed the frozen sources and independently reproduced
every stored containment boolean. All 12 Qwen outputs were non-empty. The
quality gates accepted `8/12` Qwen and `10/12` Whisper outputs. Raw Whisper had
one exact phrase hit, but that row failed the frozen timestamp-quality gate,
so the predeclared gated count correctly remained `0/12`.

Private task-type inspection found one direct literal-phrase/name request, one
semantic conversation request, and ten tasks that did not support exact
transcript containment. As a descriptive post-hoc check, mean unordered
official-answer token recall was `0.035` for Qwen and `0.212` for Whisper.
That check is non-promotional because official VQA answers are still not
transcript references. No row identities, questions, answers, transcripts, or
row-level scores are published.

## Separate completed Gemini 3.7 Flash native-AV smoke

Google documents stable `gemini-3.7-flash` as a native-multimodal model and
records its 2026-08-13 GA release on the [official model
page](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-3.7-flash) and
[changelog](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/changelog). A separate
same-media two-video Batch smoke is now complete against
`gemini-3.1-pro-preview`. Both arms received the same WebM bytes and direct
answer prompt at four FPS; the 3.7 arm omitted the sampling controls deprecated
for Gemini 3.6 and later.

Both models returned two non-empty answers, both arms had `42,842` prompt
tokens inside the frozen custom-FPS band, and observed total cost was
`$0.067445`. The immutable strict freeze is `not_ready` solely because Batch
responses returned each exact requested model alias rather than the catalog's
separate dated version string. That freeze remains unchanged. A bounded
no-new-inference diagnostic found both models semantically correct on both
rows in an unblinded manual check. Exact match was `0/2` for both; 3.7 Flash
won one token-F1 comparison and lost one, with mean token F1 `0.2496` versus
`0.4365` for 3.1 Pro. The candidate answers were more verbose, so this lexical
gap is not a semantic failure.

The smoke confirms that stable Gemini 3.7 Flash can complete this native-AV
path. It provides no evidence that Flash is better than the 3.1 Pro control
and does not trigger a larger run. The sanitized aggregate is
[`summary.json`](artifacts/gemini37-flash-two-video-smoke-20260816/summary.json).
